 FAFSA and Community Scholarship Workshop — Nov. 18 @ 6:30 p.m.
 November 16 , 2026 
 FAFSA and Community Scholarship Workshop — Wednesday, Nov. 18
6:30 p.m. | South Cafeteria 
 Seniors and families are invited to attend a workshop offering assistance with the FAFSA (Free Application for Federal Student Aid) and information about the OPRF Community Foundation Scholarship. Staff will be available to answer questions and help families navigate the financial aid and scholarship application processes.
 Please RSVP here  so we can ensure adequate staff support.
 For additional FAFSA assistance, contact ISAC representative Mackenzie Ramonez at (708) 738-9864 or  Mackenzie.Ramonez@Illinois.gov
